name: Aoi Umi de Yarisuteya ~Zangyaku! Namadori Live~
original_name: 蒼い海でヤりすてや～残虐！ 生撮りライブ～
source:
A middle-aged painter is a big fan of national idol Saori. He dreams about making her portrait and with that intentions finds a way to the fan-club exclusive voyage on a luxurious cruiser where Saori gives a concert. But negative emotions prevail, and events take an unexpected turn...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名中年画家是国民偶像沙织的狂热粉丝。他梦想为她绘制肖像，为此想方设法登上了一艘豪华游轮，参加仅限粉丝俱乐部成员参与的航行；沙织将在船上举行演唱会。然而，负面情绪最终占据上风，事态也转向了意想不到的方向……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
